purpose: Override files that a mod (or the loader) rewrites when the game loads. Their bytes in a built import are captured from a game-run profile (PR50 base, carried unchanged into R4), so they differ from release_030/overrides without any intended content change. Source-vs-package parity checks ignore these paths; do not hand-sync them.
evidence: Classified 15 Oct 2026 against R4 ZIP SHA256 31b037a710320c840bcede26003f46a7219fb1e14e14674d35efcf4e086e6c6d and PR50 base SHA256 dd72daac0fef6c42f758728abc9b003d680b791ccfe174975ec4424cf1ad3d9f. In every case R4 bytes == PR50 base bytes. 'jar_string' = the config file name occurs in the named mod's classes in the installed (R4-pinned) JAR; 'inferred' = name is built at runtime, writer taken from the config namespace.
